features.featureTitle:
Add a persistent bottom “buying” CTA that stays continuously visible at the bottom of the viewport while the user scrolls the landing page, and ensure it triggers the existing UPI payment flow.

- Implement this as a sticky/fixed bottom bar rendered on the landing page (`frontend/src/pages/TechifyLandingPage.tsx`).
- The bottom CTA must call the existing `initiatePayment` function from `useUpiPayment(...)` (same behavior as the hero CTA buttons, including deep-link + fallback dialog).
- Ensure the bottom bar is visible across common screen sizes (mobile and desktop) and does not obscure important content (add appropriate bottom padding/margin to the page content so the last sections remain readable and tappable).
- Keep all user-facing text in English.
